items.title: Mcbee interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2020
items.q: my new, my recently married Verena

ctx.x: “Lady Bugg” originated from a jam session that we had a neighbor’s house in Maine, in Yarmouth, Maine. I had some wonderful neighbors and we were having a party and I sat at the piano and my new, my recently married Verena, who you just met, she would sing something. So I just tried something in D minor and that’s how that tune sprang and how it came alive.
